title: Anthropic Appoints First Global Affairs Officer: Cuellar, Former President of the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, Takes the Role, Betting on AI Policy Competition

content_html:
Anthropic announced the appointment of Mariano-Florentino Cuellar as the company's first Chief Global Affairs Officer. This newly created position marks the AI safety-driven company's formal expansion in the global policy arena.

According to Reuters, Cuellar will report directly to the company's co-founder and president, Daniela Amodei, based at Anthropic's headquarters in San Francisco. He will lead the company's policy development, strategic international engagement, and government relations efforts globally.

A Legal Scholar with a Career Spanning Judiciary and Think Tanks

Public records show that Cuellar is an American-Mexican legal scholar and public policy expert with a unique background. He served as a judge on the California Supreme Court from 2014 to 2021, and then became the president of the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace from November 2021 to June 2026. This century-old think tank has significant influence in global policy circles, focusing on international security, economic governance, and emerging technology issues.

From a supreme court judge to the head of an international think tank, and now to a global affairs officer at an AI company, Cuellar's career has consistently revolved around the intersection of law, policy, and global governance. The appointment of such a figure, who combines judicial depth with international vision, indicates that Anthropic is shifting its policy strategy from "reactive responses" to "proactive construction."

AI Policy Has Become the Main Battlefield, and Anthropic Needs a Policy Expert

The context of this appointment cannot be ignored. AI regulation has become a global policy focus—The U.S. government is advancing an AI model evaluation framework, and models from OpenAI and Anthropic have repeatedly shown inappropriate behavior in security tests. Disputes over restrictions on Chinese open-source models have also created deep divisions between Washington and Silicon Valley. At the same time, Anthropic itself is accelerating its IPO preparations, and each policy variable could directly impact its valuation and market prospects.

Establishing a Chief Global Affairs Officer and hiring a high-profile policy figure at this critical moment clearly shows Anthropic's intent: technical leadership alone is not enough to win the AI competition. Those who can secure a seat at the table for global regulatory rule-making will have the upper hand in the next stage of industry consolidation. As Cuellar moves from a think tank to an AI company, on the other side of this revolving door lies the increasingly close and complex front line of the ongoing battle between the AI industry and policymakers.

content_html_zh:
Anthropic 宣布任命 Mariano-Florentino Cuellar 为公司首任首席全球事务官。 这一新设立的职位标志着这家以人工智能安全为导向的公司在全球政策领域的正式扩张。

据路透社报道，Cuellar 将直接向位于旧金山 Anthropic 总部的公司联合创始人兼总裁 Daniela Amodei 汇报工作。 他将领导公司的政策制定、战略性国际参与以及全球政府关系工作。

职业生涯横跨司法和智库的法律学者

公开记录显示，奎利亚尔是一位具有独特背景的美墨法律学者和公共政策专家。 他于2014年至2021年担任加州最高法院法官，随后于2021年11月至2026年6月担任卡内基国际和平基金会主席。 这个百年智库在全球政策界具有重要影响力，关注国际安全、经济治理和新兴技术问题。

从最高法院法官到国际智库负责人，再到如今一家人工智能公司的全球事务官员，奎利亚尔的职业生涯始终围绕着法律、政策和全球治理的交叉领域。 这样一位兼具司法深度和国际视野的人物的上任，标志着人智正在将政策策略从“被动应对”转向“主动建设”。

AI政策已成主战场，人类需要政策专家

此次任命的背景不容忽视。 人工智能监管已成为全球政策焦点——美国政府正在推进人工智能模型评估框架，OpenAI和Anthropic的模型在安全测试中屡屡表现出不当行为。 关于限制中国开源模式的争议也造成了华盛顿和硅谷之间的深刻分歧。 与此同时，Anthropic本身也在加速IPO准备工作，每一个政策变量都可能直接影响其估值和市场前景。

在这个关键时刻设立首席全球事务官并聘请高调的政策人物，清楚地表明了Anthropic的意图：仅靠技术领导力不足以赢得人工智能竞争。 那些能够在全球监管规则制定中占据一席之地的人将在下一阶段的行业整合中占据上风。 随着奎利亚尔从一家智库转变为一家人工智能公司，旋转门的另一边是人工智能行业与政策制定者之间持续不断的斗争的日益密切和复杂的前线。
